notes: Metrica Sports sample game 1: one professional match, both teams pooled (team A a back four, team B a back three), measured by soccer.coaching.series on the result tools/team_shape_bench.build_result makes of it (5 samples a second, the half-time side swap set). All the time with all 10 outfield players of the team observed, dead ball included, because a PitchIQ result has no in-play mask; the in-play variant is kept per metric as inPlay. No possession phase: Metrica has no event record here and PitchIQ records none, so every distribution mixes the phases (a team is about 10 m wider with the ball). Each team spends about 10% of its time above the p90 by construction: a count is compared with the professional window distribution of the same rule, context and measured minutes (windowCounts), never read on its own. A sanity range from one match, not a standard; game 2 is held out for validation.

contexts.all: every eligible sample, dead ball included (PitchIQ results have no in-play mask)
contexts.third: the pitch third of the team's outfield centre from its own goal line (series.third: own below L/3, final above 2L/3)
contexts.backline: the number of defenders in the back line (series.lineSize); team A's back four and team B's back three
contexts.unit: the player's unit at the sample (series.group: D the back line, M every middle line, F the front line)
contexts.window: lagDM / corrDM: all = 30 s windows, window:20 = 20 s windows, starting 5 s apart

width.definition: Across-pitch extent of the team's outfield players (series.width: team_shape.width_depth_series, complete or reliable samples).

depth.definition: Along-pitch extent of the team's outfield players (series.depth).

hull.definition: Convex hull area of the outfield players (series.hull, complete samples).

spread.definition: RMS distance of the outfield players to their centroid (series.spread, complete samples).

gapDM.definition: Mean depth of the first midfield line (the formation template's line index 1) minus the defensive unit's, both units complete and every member observed (series.gapDM).

gapMF.definition: Mean depth of the forward line minus that of every middle line (series.gapMF).

lineStd.definition: Standard deviation of the defenders' distances from their own goal line: team_shape.defensive_line complete samples of the formation back line, not disrupted (series.lineStd).

lineHeight.definition: Median distance of the defenders from their own goal line (series.lineHeight).

nearestTeammate.definition: Distance from an outfield player to the nearest outfield teammate, per player and sample (series.nearestTeammate); unit:D|M|F by the player's unit (series.group).

tau.note: no strength is ever claimed on it (isolation is at most a review)

lagDM.definition: Seconds the defence's sideways movement trails the midfield's over a 30 s window (positive: the defence moves later): the lag of reference.lateral_windows(t, midfield, defence) on reference.dm_velocities, both units complete, windows at the search bound left out; window:20 for 20 s windows. Quantiles at the 5 Hz resolution (multiples of 0.2 s).

default.count: late windows among the non-overlapping ones
late windows among the non-overlapping ones

tau.basis: share of 30 s windows beyond the 'all' context's p75 (0.4)

corrDM.definition: Peak correlation of the defence's and the midfield's sideways velocities over the window (the same windows as lagDM).
